examples.arabic: بابا بحب يلبس تي شيرت قطن بالصيف
examples.english: Dad likes to wear a cotton t-shirt in summer.
examples.transliteration: Baba baḥebb yilbas ti-sheert qoṭon biṣ-ṣeif.

examples.arabic: سامي قال بحب البس تي شيرت قطن
examples.english: Sami said: I like to wear a cotton t-shirt.
examples.transliteration: Sami aal: Baḥebb albass ti-sheert qoṭon.

examples.arabic: اخدنا كنزة قطن صغيرة وهلأ احمد سعيد
examples.english: We took a small cotton sweater and now Ahmad is happy.
examples.transliteration: Akhadna kanze qoṭon ṣghiire w-halla' Ahmad saʿiid.

examples.arabic: رنا قالت بحب البس تي شيرت قطن
examples.english: Rana said, "I like to wear cotton t-shirts."
examples.transliteration: Rana aalet baḥebb albass ti-sheert qoṭon.

examples.arabic: الجو كان بارد شوي فانا لبست كنزة قطن
examples.english: The weather was a bit cold so I wore a cotton sweater
examples.transliteration: El-jaww kaan baared shwayy fa-ana labast kanze qoṭon
